verdict.rationale: Vast.ai ships an official Python SDK in its vast-cli repo, with calls such as `vast.search_offers`, `show_instances` and `start_instance`, plus a serverless client for endpoint inference. The docs present the SDK as a peer of the CLI, built on the REST API, and a published OpenAPI spec supports building against the API. missing for 10: official SDKs beyond Python (no other languages evidenced), in-depth SDK reference docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
